messages.subject: methylBase obj
parts: Hi, I have a methylBase.obj with 19 samples and I would like to know if it is possible to filter this object (without convert to a data.frame) based on coverage by sample and re-plot the hierarchical cluster

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methylBase obj
parts:
yes, you can, basically [] notation should work as it would work on a data.frame but return a methylBase object when filtering rows.

library(methylKit)
data(methylKit)
methylBase.obj[methylBase.obj$coverage1 > 10, ]
